target.statement: No original quantitative result exists to reproduce: the paper is a survey whose contributions are conceptual (a three-level Cognitive Hierarchy and a taxonomy of seven reasoning challenges). The only numbers are third-party benchmark metadata copied into Table 2, e.g. DriveLM-Bench (19,200 frames / 20,498 QA pairs) or OmniDrive (486 GitHub stars); these are descriptive counts, not experimental results of this work.
target.dataset: N/A - no dataset introduced or used by the paper

compute.basis: The paper is a review with no experiments, models, code or data of its own; every link it lists points to a third-party benchmark repository, so the only 'target' (a Table 1/Table 2 cell) is quoted metadata that requires no execution.

blockers: Survey paper: no original experiments, no released artifact, no training or evaluation pipeline to re-run
The paper's headline claims (cognitive hierarchy, seven reasoning challenges) are qualitative and cannot be validated by a single number
All 12 listed repositories belong to cited third-party benchmarks, not to this work, so reproducing one of them would not reproduce this paper's contribution

Any real target here (e.g. DriveLM-Bench or NuScenes-QA) would require driving datasets of tens-to-hundreds of GB plus multi-GPU VLM training, far beyond the laptop budget and irrelevant to the survey
title: A Survey of Reasoning in Autonomous Driving Systems: Open Challenges and Emerging Paradigms
